scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.build:js: terser assets/riviantrackr.js -c -m -o assets/riviantrackr.min.js && terser assets/riviantrackr-trending.js -c -m -o assets/riviantrackr-trending.min.js && terser assets/riviantrackr-admin.js -c -m -o assets/riviantrackr-admin.min.js
scripts.build:css: cleancss -o assets/riviantrackr.min.css assets/riviantrackr.css && cleancss -o assets/riviantrackr-admin.min.css assets/riviantrackr-admin.css
